svg.title: Hygieia pipeline (v0.2)
svg.desc: Hygieia pipeline. Inputs: the native semantic/metrics.yml with an optional schema.sql, plus read-only adapt dbt and adapt ossie adapters that map external semantic models into metrics.yml. audit checks nine rule classes R1-R9; rot injects five drifts (three structural, two semantic) and re-runs audit; eval scores two arms against executed gold SQL. All three feed report, which writes reports/health-report.md. Two dashed consumers sit alongside: a CI gate (audit --fail-on high plus SARIF through a composite Action) and an agent gate that audits before answering. impact maps a git diff to affected metrics.
